flows:
Navigate to https://kaneai-playground.lambdatest.io then Complete the wizard up to the login step: click Enable Notification, choose Safari, then switch to Mobile App.
On the email and password form, leave both fields empty and click Submit.
Assert a popup "Required Fields Missing" appears with the text "Please enter both email and password." and the wizard did not advance to the final screen.
